licence.leaseMustBeValidToRenew.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Creative City (Fujairah Creative City Media Free Zone), lease (unknown: the official rules set no lease rule for renewal); https://creativecity.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Rules_and_Regulations-June2025.pdf

licence.leaseMinRemainingDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Creative City (Fujairah Creative City Media Free Zone), lease (the official rules set no lease remaining rule; the 30 day rule applies to licence validity); https://creativecity.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Rules_and_Regulations-June2025.pdf

licence.renewalWindow.value: Renew before expiry. Submit renewal or cancellation requirements well before expiry, because no service request is processed once licence validity is under 30 days. Renewal can be for 1 to 10 years.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Creative City (Fujairah Creative City Media Free Zone), renewal window (Creative City Rules and Regulations (June 2025) 1.14, 1.15 and 1.5, CONFIRMED); https://creativecity.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Rules_and_Regulations-June2025.pdf

licence.renewsTogether.value: The establishment card, if one exists, is tracked separately, with its own late fine after 28 days past card expiry. Residence visas must be renewed or cancelled before expiry. Lease or flexi desk renewal: unknown.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Creative City (Fujairah Creative City Media Free Zone), renews together (Creative City Rules and Regulations (June 2025) 1.16 and 2.3, CONFIRMED; amounts left out); https://creativecity.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Rules_and_Regulations-June2025.pdf

licence.afterExpiry.value: If the licence is not renewed or cancelled within the period, a capped monthly late fine applies. Services may be suspended for overdue payments. 90 days after licence expiry, Creative City may take legal action and demand settlement of fines on the licence and visas. No automatic deregistration threshold is stated.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Creative City (Fujairah Creative City Media Free Zone), late renewal (Creative City Rules and Regulations (June 2025) 1.16, 1.17 and 1.22, CONFIRMED; amounts left out. A consultancy claim of annulment after 60 days is not in the official rules); https://creativecity.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Rules_and_Regulations-June2025.pdf

licence.graceDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Creative City (Fujairah Creative City Media Free Zone), late renewal (no grace period stated in the official rules); https://creativecity.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Rules_and_Regulations-June2025.pdf

value.consequence: Creative City may take legal action and demand settlement of what is owed on the licence and visas.
